segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The heavy oak door of the Rusty Anchor groans open, letting in a bitter mountain draft that makes the guttering tallow candles flicker.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Kael steps into the dim, smoke-choked common room, his chain mail clinking softly against the damp night air.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Two squat, green-skinned figures clad in scavenged leather stand atop a splintered wooden table, tearing into a loaf of dark bread with jagged daggers.

segments.speaker: Goblin Scout
segments.text: More meat for the pot, Nazz!

suggestions.text: Draw your longsword and step forward to challenge the goblins
Keep your hand on your sword hilt and demand to know what they've done to the tavern keeper
Charge instantly at the nearest goblin to catch them off guard

segments.text: Kael's sharp eyes sweep past the two snarling creatures, scanning the shadowy corners of the common room.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Overturned chairs and shattered mugs litter the sticky floor, but no other foes stir in the gloom.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The two goblins hiss in unison, clutching their rusted daggers tighter as they realize they are cornered.

segments.speaker: Goblin Raider
segments.text: Kill the tall one, Nazz! Make it bleed!

suggestions.text: Draw your longsword and step toward the Goblin Scout

Stand your ground behind your shield and wait for their charge

turns.action: I carefully examine the tavern for any other threats.

segments.text: Kael ignores the shrieking goblins for a moment, sidestepping toward the blood-spattered bar counter where a motionless bundle of robes lies behind the wood.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: As Kael reaches the counter, the Goblin Scout leaps off the table, lunging forward with its jagged blade aimed at Kael's exposed side.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Kael pivots his heavy shield just in time, deflecting the rusted dagger with a loud, metallic clang.
